message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red background with white and black text. At the top, the white word "TEMPO" is dominant. Above it, smaller text reads "Cara Kotor Meredam Demonstrasi H.28" and "Main Api Saldo Anggaran H.72". Below the title, the phrase "SATUAN PARA PENIKMAT GIZI" appears in large white capital letters. A paragraph of smaller white text describes a legal situation involving "Sony Sonjaya" and "makan bergizi gratis."

The visual elements include a pair of light-skinned hands in the upper right. The wrists are bound by blue metal handcuffs with a grey chain. The right hand’s index finger is extended, touching the end of a line of blue, multi-compartment food trays. These trays, which look like plastic cafeteria meal containers, are arranged diagonally across the bottom left of the frame. They are tipped over and overlapping like fallen dominoes. At the bottom right, a barcode, a QR code, the date "6-12 JULI 2026," and the price "RP 60.000" are printed in black. A small white "53" is positioned next to the "O" in "TEMPO."
